items.title: Java, Java, Java: Object-Oriented Problem Solving (3rd Edition)
items.author: Ralph Morelli; Ralph Walde
items.description: A comprehensive introductory textbook on object-oriented programming and problem solving in Java.
items.attribution: Ralph Morelli and Ralph Walde, Java, Java, Java: Object-Oriented Problem Solving, 3rd Edition, Trinity College, 2017. Licensed CC BY 4.0. Preserve the original attribution and license notice in the PDF.

items.title: Deep into Pharo
items.author: Alexandre Bergel; Damien Cassou; Stéphane Ducasse; Jannik Laval
items.description: An open programming textbook covering Pharo frameworks, libraries, language features, and development tools.
items.attribution: Alexandre Bergel, Damien Cassou, Stéphane Ducasse, and Jannik Laval, Deep into Pharo, Square Bracket Associates, 2013. Licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering I
items.author: Don H. Johnson
items.description: An introductory electrical engineering text covering signals, systems, and the foundations of communication engineering.
items.attribution: Don H. Johnson, Fundamentals of Electrical Engineering I, Rice University, 2016. Licensed under the Creative Commons Attribution 1.0 License. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Combinatorics Through Guided Discovery
items.author: Kenneth P. Bogart; Mitchel T. Keller; Oscar Levin; Kent E. Morrison
items.description: An inquiry-based introduction to combinatorics, counting, induction, recursion, generating functions, and graph theory.
items.attribution: Kenneth P. Bogart, Combinatorics Through Guided Discovery, PreTeXt edition edited by Mitchel T. Keller, Oscar Levin, and Kent E. Morrison. Licensed under GNU Free Documentation License 1.3 or later. Preserve the original license appendix and attribution.

items.title: Calculus-Based Physics II
items.author: Jeffrey W. Schnick
items.description: A second-semester calculus-based physics textbook covering electricity, magnetism, circuits, electromagnetic waves, and optics.
items.attribution: Jeffrey W. Schnick, Calculus-Based Physics II, 2008. Licensed CC BY-SA 2.5 except where otherwise noted, as recorded by BCcampus. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Math in Society
items.author: David Lippman
items.description: A liberal-arts mathematics survey covering voting theory, fair division, graph theory, growth models, finance, statistics, probability, sets, and logic.
items.attribution: David Lippman, Math in Society, Version 2.6, July 2022. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution-ShareAlike 4.0 International. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Linear Algebra (4th Edition)
items.author: Jim Hefferon
items.description: An open undergraduate linear algebra textbook covering linear systems, matrices, vector spaces, linear maps, determinants, eigenvalues, and applications.
items.attribution: Jim Hefferon, Linear Algebra, 4th Edition, 2020. Licensed under GNU Free Documentation License 1.2 or later (also available under CC BY 3.0 US). This import uses the GFDL grant; preserve the original license appendix and attribution.

items.title: Discrete Mathematics: An Open Introduction (3rd Edition)
items.author: Oscar Levin
items.description: An inquiry-based introduction to discrete mathematics, including counting, sequences, logic, proofs, graph theory, and number theory.
items.attribution: Oscar Levin, Discrete Mathematics: An Open Introduction, 3rd Edition, 2019. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Open Data Structures (Java Edition)
items.author: Pat Morin
items.description: An open computer-science textbook on the implementation and analysis of lists, queues, dictionaries, search trees, heaps, and graphs.
items.attribution: Pat Morin, Open Data Structures, Java Edition. Licensed under Creative Commons Attribution 2.5 Canada. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Modern Physics: With Waves, Thermodynamics, and Optics
items.author: Benjamin Crowell
items.description: A sophomore-level calculus-based physics textbook focused on waves, quantum physics, relativity, thermodynamics, and optics.
items.attribution: Benjamin Crowell, Modern Physics: With Waves, Thermodynamics, and Optics, 2021. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0 as recorded in Internet Archive metadata. Preserve the original attribution and all figure credits.

items.title: Electromagnetics, Volume 1
items.author: Steven W. Ellingson
items.description: An undergraduate engineering electromagnetics textbook covering electric fields, potentials, and foundational electromagnetic theory.
items.attribution: Steven W. Ellingson, Electromagnetics, Volume 1, Virginia Tech Publishing, 2018. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Electromagnetics, Volume 2
items.author: Steven W. Ellingson
items.description: An undergraduate engineering electromagnetics text covering magnetostatics, wave propagation, waveguides, transmission lines, optical fiber, and antennas.
items.attribution: Steven W. Ellingson, Electromagnetics, Volume 2, Virginia Tech Publishing, 2020. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Computer Networking: Principles, Protocols and Practice
items.author: Olivier Bonaventure
items.description: An undergraduate textbook explaining Internet architecture, networking layers, addressing, routing, transport protocols, and applications.
items.attribution: Olivier Bonaventure, Computer Networking: Principles, Protocols and Practice, Open Textbooks for Hong Kong, 2016. Licensed CC BY-SA 4.0. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Operating Systems and Middleware: Supporting Controlled Interaction (Revised Edition 1.3.1)
items.author: Max Hailperin
items.description: An open computer-science textbook covering operating-system concepts, middleware, processes, concurrency, interfaces, and controlled interaction.
items.attribution: Max Hailperin, Operating Systems and Middleware: Supporting Controlled Interaction, Revised Edition 1.3.1. Licensed CC BY-SA 3.0 Unported. Preserve the original attribution and image credits; the Seagate photo is licensed only as part of the complete book and must not be extracted separately.

items.title: Calculus-Based Physics I
items.author: Jeffrey W. Schnick
items.description: A calculus-based first-semester physics text for science and engineering students, covering mechanics, energy, momentum, rotation, and waves.
items.attribution: Jeffrey W. Schnick, Calculus-Based Physics I, 2005–2008. Licensed CC BY-SA 3.0. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.

items.title: Basics of Fluid Mechanics
items.author: Genick Bar-Meir
items.description: An open engineering textbook introducing fluid mechanics and its core principles and applications.
items.attribution: Genick Bar-Meir, Basics of Fluid Mechanics, Potto Project, Version 0.7.0 pre-release, 2023. Licensed under GNU Free Documentation License 1.2 or later (or the separate Potto license). This import uses the GFDL grant; preserve the original license appendix.

items.title: A Gentle Introduction to the Art of Mathematics
items.author: Joseph E. Fields
items.description: A proof-oriented mathematics text introducing logic, sets, relations, functions, cardinality, and mathematical proof techniques.
items.attribution: Joseph E. Fields, A Gentle Introduction to the Art of Mathematics, Version 3.1, 2013. Licensed under GNU Free Documentation License 1.3 or later. Preserve the original license appendix and attribution.

items.title: Vector Calculus
items.author: Michael Corral
items.description: A multivariable calculus textbook for students who have completed single-variable calculus, with exercises and selected answers.
items.attribution: Michael Corral, Vector Calculus, latest version dated 2022-08-15. Licensed under GNU Free Documentation License 1.2. Preserve the original license and author attribution.

items.title: A First Course in Linear Algebra
items.author: Robert A. Beezer
items.description: An undergraduate linear algebra textbook covering systems, matrices, vector spaces, linear transformations, determinants, and eigenvalues.
items.attribution: Robert A. Beezer, A First Course in Linear Algebra, Version 2.22. Licensed under GNU Free Documentation License 1.2 or later. Preserve the original license appendix and author attribution.

items.title: Programming Fundamentals: A Modular Structured Approach Using C++
items.author: Kenneth Leroy Busbee
items.description: An introductory programming text covering structured programming, problem solving, functions, conditions, loops, arrays, and object-oriented concepts.
items.attribution: Kenneth Leroy Busbee, Programming Fundamentals: A Modular Structured Approach Using C++, Open Library / eCampusOntario, 2013. Licensed CC BY 3.0. Preserve the original attribution and license notice.
